iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FindJob"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/find-a-job">

  <bpmn:message id="msgApplication" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgConfirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgApplicationRating" name="Application rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgJobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgInterview" name="Interview negotiation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgEmploymentOffer" name="Employment offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgProbationCompleted" name="Probation completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgCompanyReview" name="Company review of applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgApplicantReview" name="Applicant review of company"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_FindJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Application" sourceRef="T_SendApp" targetRef="SC_S1"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" sourceRef="TC1" targetRef="R_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ApplicationRating" sourceRef="TC3" targetRef="R_Rating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ProbationCompleted" sourceRef="T_Complete" targetRef="SC_S2"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CompanyReview" sourceRef="TC5" targetRef="C_CompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ApplicantReview" sourceRef="T_RateCompany" targetRef="TC6"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InterviewInvite" sourceRef="TC8" targetRef="C_Interview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EmploymentOffer" sourceRef="TC9" targetRef="C_Employment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_JobOffer" sourceRef="TC10" targetRef="C_Offer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Applicant process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="S_Search" name="Job search started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_Write" name="Write job application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="T_SendApp" name="Send job application" messageRef="msgApplication"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="R_Confirm" name="Receive application confirmation" messageRef="msgConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="R_Rating" name="Receive application rating" messageRef="msgApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_Report" name="Report applied companies"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EBG_Wait" name="Company response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_Offer" name="Potential job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Offer" messageRef="msgJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_Interview" name="Job interview negotiated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Interview" messageRef="msgInterview"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_Employment" name="Employment offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Employment" messageRef="msgEmploymentOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="M_Loop" name="Merge before reporting"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_Attend" name="Attend job interview"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_Enter" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_Complete" name="Complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="P1" name="Start rating"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="TMR_OneYear" name="One year after rating">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TMD_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_ViewReviews" name="View company reviews"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_CompanyRating" name="Company rating received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyRating" messageRef="msgCompanyReview"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="P2" name="Ratings complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_Perm" name="Job becomes permanent?" default="F_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_Rate" name="Rated company C or less?" default="F_RateAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving job offers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="E_OffersOnly" name="Job offers received without reporting"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="E_Ended" name="Job search ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_01" sourceRef="S_Search" targetRef="T_Write"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_02" sourceRef="T_Write" targetRef="T_SendApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_03" sourceRef="T_SendApp" targetRef="R_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_04" sourceRef="R_Confirm" targetRef="R_Rating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_05" sourceRef="R_Rating" targetRef="T_Report"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_06" sourceRef="T_Report" targetRef="EBG_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_07" sourceRef="EBG_Wait" targetRef="C_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_08" sourceRef="EBG_Wait" targetRef="C_Interview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_09" sourceRef="EBG_Wait" targetRef="C_Employment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_10" sourceRef="C_Offer" targetRef="M_Loop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_11" sourceRef="C_Interview" targetRef="T_Attend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_12" sourceRef="T_Attend" targetRef="M_Loop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_13" sourceRef="C_Employment" targetRef="T_Enter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_14" sourceRef="T_Enter" targetRef="T_Complete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_15" sourceRef="T_Complete" targetRef="P1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_16" sourceRef="P1" targetRef="T_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_17" sourceRef="P1" targetRef="C_CompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_18" sourceRef="T_RateCompany" targetRef="TMR_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_19" sourceRef="TMR_OneYear" targetRef="T_ViewReviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_20" sourceRef="T_ViewReviews" targetRef="P2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_21" sourceRef="C_CompanyRating" targetRef="P2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_22" sourceRef="P2" targetRef="G_Perm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Permanent" sourceRef="G_Perm" targetRef="G_Rate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${jobPermanent}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_NotPermanent" sourceRef="G_Perm" targetRef="M_Loop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_RateCOrLess" sourceRef="G_Rate" targetRef="T_ContinueOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${ratingCOrLess}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_RateAboveC" sourceRef="G_Rate" targetRef="E_Ended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_23" sourceRef="T_ContinueOffers" targetRef="E_OffersOnly"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_24" sourceRef="M_Loop" targetRef="T_Report"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="SC_S1" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AppReceived" messageRef="msgApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TC1" name="Confirm application receipt" messageRef="msgConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="TC2" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TC3" name="Send application rating" messageRef="msgApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EC1" name="Application rated"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="SC_S2" name="Probation completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ProbationDone" messageRef="msgProbationCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="TC4" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TC5" name="Send company review" messageRef="msgCompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="TC6" name="Receive applicant review" messageRef="msgApplicantReview"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EC2" name="Ratings exchanged"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="SC_S3" name="Company wants to hire applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TC9" name="Send employment offer" messageRef="msgEmploymentOffer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EC3" name="Employment offered"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="SC_S4" name="Interview requested"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TC8" name="Negotiate job interview" messageRef="msgInterview"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EC4" name="Interview negotiated"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="SC_S5" name="Potential match found"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TC10" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="msgJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EC5" name="Potential job offer sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_01" sourceRef="SC_S1" targetRef="TC1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_02" sourceRef="TC1" targetRef="TC2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_03" sourceRef="TC2" targetRef="TC3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_04" sourceRef="TC3" targetRef="EC1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_05" sourceRef="SC_S2" targetRef="TC4"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_06" sourceRef="TC4" targetRef="TC5"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_07" sourceRef="TC5" targetRef="TC6"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_08" sourceRef="TC6" targetRef="EC2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_09" sourceRef="SC_S3" targetRef="TC9"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_10" sourceRef="TC9" targetRef="EC3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_11" sourceRef="SC_S4" targetRef="TC8"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_12" sourceRef="TC8" targetRef="EC4"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_13" sourceRef="SC_S5" targetRef="TC10"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_14" sourceRef="TC10" targetRef="EC5"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
